theorem norm_gammaWallCommutator_le_exp

    (hzero : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → χ x = 0) (hone : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → χ x = 1)

by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM 0)
  have hΛ : 1 ≤ Λ := one_le_of_cutoff_lipschitz hlip hzero hone
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * Λ * M := by positivity
  have hCfin : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 24 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-|L|) := by positivity
  -- the cutoff differences vanish on the whole window `0 < s ≤ |L| - 1`
  have hvanish : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ |L| - 1 →
      gammaJumpKernel s • ((χ L - χ (L + s)) • F (L + s) + (χ L - χ (L - s)) • F (L - s))
        = 0 := by
    intro s hs hsle
    rcases le_or_gt 0 L with hLpos | hLneg
    · have hLabs : |L| = L := abs_of_nonneg hLpos
      rw [hLabs] at hL hsle
      rw [hone L (by linarith), hone (L + s) (by linarith), hone (L - s) (by linarith)]
      simp
    · have hLabs : |L| = -L := abs_of_neg hLneg
      rw [hLabs] at hL hsle
      rw [hzero L (by linarith), hzero (L + s) (by linarith), hzero (L - s) (by linarith)]
      simp
  have hkey : ‖gammaWallCommutator χ F L‖ₑ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (24 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-|L|)) := by
    have hstep : ∫⁻ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖gammaJumpKernel s •
        ((χ L - χ (L + s)) • F (L + s) + (χ L - χ (L - s)) • F (L - s))‖ₑ
          ≤ ∫⁻ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Ioi (|L| - 1)).indicator
              (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (8 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-s))) s := by
      refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi ?_
      intro s hs
      by_cases hcase : s ∈ Ioi (|L| - 1)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hcase]
        exact enorm_gammaWallCommutator_integrand_le hlip hzero hone hM hs
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hcase, hvanish s hs (not_lt.mp hcase)]
        simp
    have hwindow : ∫⁻ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Ioi (|L| - 1)).indicator
        (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (8 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-s))) s
          = ENNReal.ofReal (8 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-(|L| - 1))) := by
      rw [lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi, Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Ioi,
        Set.Ioi_inter_Ioi, max_eq_left (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |L| - 1),
        lintegral_ofReal_const_mul_exp_neg hC]
    have hcompare : (8 : ℝ) * Λ * M * Real.exp (-(|L| - 1))
        ≤ 24 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-|L|) := by
      have hexp : Real.exp (-(|L| - 1)) = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-|L|) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have h3 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := by
        have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
        linarith
      have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-|L|) := Real.exp_pos _
      rw [hexp]
      nlinarith [hpos, hM0, hΛ]
    calc ‖gammaWallCommutator χ F L‖ₑ
        ≤ ∫⁻ s in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖gammaJumpKernel s •
            ((χ L - χ (L + s)) • F (L + s) + (χ L - χ (L - s)) • F (L - s))‖ₑ :=
          enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-(|L| - 1))) := hstep.trans (le_of_eq hwindow)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (24 * Λ * M * Real.exp (-|L|)) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hcompare
  rwa [← ofReal_norm, ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hCfin] at hkey

# Modular cubic projection transgression

Ordinary trace kills the nuclear associator of three projection polarizations.  A source modular
weight need not: its sigma-trace law converts every commutator into an exact modular displacement.
This file proves the resulting cubic transgression in an arbitrary noncommutative ring and gives a
closed two-dimensional witness whose ordinary trace is zero while its modular cubic anomaly is
nonzero.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

section Generic

variable {A G : Type*} [Ring A] [AddCommGroup G]

/-- Noncommutative commutator, named locally to avoid choosing a topological operator category. -/
def modularCommutator (x y : A) : A := x * y - y * x

/-- Failure of cubic projection displacement to add through an intermediate polarization. -/
def cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra (r q p : A) : A :=
  (r - p) ^ 3 - (r - q) ^ 3 - (q - p) ^ 3

/-- A sigma-trace: cyclic rotation is accompanied by the source modular automorphism. -/
def IsSigmaTrace (sigma : A →+* A) (tau : A →+ G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, tau (x * y) = tau (sigma y * x)

/-- Exact operator-valued modular correction to cubic projection additivity. -/
def cubicProjectionModularAnomaly (sigma : A →+* A) (r q p : A) : A :=
  let a := r - q
  let b := q - p
  3 • ((sigma q - q) * (a * b)) +
    (sigma a - a) * (a * b) +
    (sigma (a ^ 2) - a ^ 2) * b +
    (sigma (a * b) - a * b) * b +
    (sigma a - a) * b ^ 2

/-- The cubic associator is a sum of five commutator channels.  Projection algebra collapses the
distinguished mixed pair to the commutator with the intermediate projection. -/
theorem cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra_eq_commutators
    (r q p : A) (hr : r * r = r) (hq : q * q = q) (hp : p * p = p) :
    cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra r q p =
      let a := r - q
      let b := q - p
      3 • modularCommutator (a * b) q +
        modularCommutator (a * b) a +
        modularCommutator b (a ^ 2) +
        modularCommutator b (a * b) +
        modularCommutator (b ^ 2) a := by
  let a := r - q
  let b := q - p
  have hlong : r - p = a + b := by
    simp only [a, b]
    noncomm_ring
  have hqqp : q * (q * p) = q * p := by rw [← mul_assoc, hq]
  have hcross : a ^ 2 * b + a * b ^ 2 = modularCommutator (a * b) q := by
    simp only [a, b, modularCommutator]
    noncomm_ring [hr, hq, hp, hqqp]
  rw [cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra, hlong]
  change (a + b) ^ 3 - a ^ 3 - b ^ 3 = _
  rw [show (a + b) ^ 3 - a ^ 3 - b ^ 3 =
      3 • (a ^ 2 * b + a * b ^ 2) +
        modularCommutator (a * b) a +
        modularCommutator b (a ^ 2) +
        modularCommutator b (a * b) +
        modularCommutator (b ^ 2) a by
      simp only [modularCommutator]
      noncomm_ring]
  rw [hcross]

/-- A sigma-trace sends an ordinary commutator to the modular displacement of its rotated
factor.  This is the basic mechanism by which source time survives ordinary trace
abelianization. -/
theorem IsSigmaTrace.map_modularCommutator
    {sigma : A →+* A} {tau : A →+ G} (h : IsSigmaTrace sigma tau)
    (x y : A) :
    tau (modularCommutator x y) = tau ((sigma y - y) * x) := by
  rw [modularCommutator, map_sub, h]
  rw [sub_mul, map_sub]

/-- **Modular cubic projection transgression.**  Under a sigma-trace, the entire cubic projection
associator is exactly the source modular anomaly. -/
theorem IsSigmaTrace.map_cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra
    {sigma : A →+* A} {tau : A →+ G} (h : IsSigmaTrace sigma tau)
    (r q p : A) (hr : r * r = r) (hq : q * q = q) (hp : p * p = p) :
    tau (cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra r q p) =
      tau (cubicProjectionModularAnomaly sigma r q p) := by
  rw [cubicProjectionAssociatorAlgebra_eq_commutators r q p hr hq hp]
  simp only [cubicProjectionModularAnomaly, map_add, map_nsmul]
  rw [h.map_modularCommutator, h.map_modularCommutator,
    h.map_modularCommutator, h.map_modularCommutator,
    h.map_modularCommutator]

/-- The new term vanishes in the tracial centralizer.  It detects failure of modular invariance,
not a new ordinary trace or a choice of phase. -/
theorem cubicProjectionModularAnomaly_eq_zero_of_fixed
    (sigma : A →+* A) (r q p : A)
    (hr : sigma r = r) (hq : sigma q = q) (hp : sigma p = p) :
    cubicProjectionModularAnomaly sigma r q p = 0 := by
  simp [cubicProjectionModularAnomaly, hr, hq, hp]

end Generic

The `{σ_p}`-boundary defect on a torsion seam presentation: the commutator model always collapses.

A pinned `{σ_p}`-boundary defect on a torsion seam presentation `A` (with `det A = Xᵐ`) is a matrix
`Δ_p` whose Fitting boundary class `tr(adj(A)·Δ_p) mod Xᵐ` decides — via `FittingSeamBoundary` —
whether it is fake (a coboundary through the presentation) or a genuine divisor obstruction. The
natural first model of a `{σ_p}`-defect is the **commutator** `Δ_p = σ·A − A·σ`: the failure of the
`{σ_p}` action `σ` to preserve the divisor presentation `A`.

This module proves that model is **always fake**: `tr(adj(A)·(σA − Aσ)) = 0` for every `A` and every
`σ` (`fittingBoundaryTrace_commutatorDefect`), because the adjugate identities
`adj(A)·A = A·adj(A) = det(A)·1` and trace cyclicity make the two cyclic traces cancel. So no
`{σ_p}`-non-commutation with the presentation produces a live pinned defect
(`fittingBoundaryClass_commutatorDefect`); a nonzero boundary class is never a commutator
(`nonzero_fittingBoundaryClass_not_commutator`).

Non-fake defects nonetheless exist (`exists_nonfake_fittingBoundary`: a one-slot presentation with
`det A = X²`, defect `1`, boundary class `1 ≠ 0`), so the commutator vanishing is a genuine
restriction, not vacuity — and every such live defect is, by the theorem, a non-commutator.

Interpretation. At a pinned strip point the `{σ_p}` action is multiplication by the unit `p^(−s)`
(nonvanishing there — the unit-triviality of the prime side), i.e. a scalar, which commutes with the
presentation; its commutator defect is therefore `0` and fake. This is the presentation-level shadow
of the disjoint-carrier/freeness collapse. A live `{σ_p}`-boundary defect must be a **non-commutator
cross-boundary cochain** — the `{σ_p}` action pushing mass across a cutoff `|x| = λ` — which is not a
pinned-germ commutator. That object is non-local (trace-level / adelic), not a pinned germ.
-/

namespace RHTower

open Matrix Polynomial

variable {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R]

/-- The commutator `{σ_p}`-defect: the failure of the action `σ` to preserve the seam presentation
`A`. -/
def commutatorDefect (A σ : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) : Matrix n n (Polynomial R) := σ * A - A * σ

/-- **The commutator defect always has zero Fitting boundary trace.**  For every presentation `A`
and every action `σ`, `tr(adj(A)·(σA − Aσ)) = 0`: the adjugate identities `adj(A)·A = A·adj(A) =
det(A)·1` and trace cyclicity make the two cyclic traces `det(A)·tr(σ)` cancel. -/
theorem fittingBoundaryTrace_commutatorDefect (A σ : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) :
    fittingBoundaryTrace A (commutatorDefect A σ) = 0 := by
  rw [fittingBoundaryTrace, commutatorDefect, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub]
  have h1 : (A.adjugate * (σ * A)).trace = (A.det • σ).trace := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm (A.adjugate * σ) A, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_adjugate, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  have h2 : (A.adjugate * (A * σ)).trace = (A.det • σ).trace := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [h1, h2, sub_self]

/-- **The commutator `{σ_p}`-defect is fake at every level.**  Its Fitting boundary class in
`R[X]/(Xᵐ)` is zero, so no failure of `σ` to commute with the presentation yields a live pinned
divisor obstruction. -/
theorem fittingBoundaryClass_commutatorDefect (m : ℕ) (A σ : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) :
    fittingBoundaryClass m A (commutatorDefect A σ) = 0 := by
  rw [fittingBoundaryClass, fittingBoundaryTrace_commutatorDefect, jetClass]
  exact map_zero _

/-- **A live boundary defect is never a commutator.**  If the Fitting boundary class of `Δ` is
nonzero, `Δ` is not `σ·A − A·σ` for any `σ`: a genuine pinned divisor obstruction must be a
non-commutator cochain. -/
theorem nonzero_fittingBoundaryClass_not_commutator (m : ℕ) {A Δ : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)}
    (hclass : fittingBoundaryClass m A Δ ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ σ : Matrix n n (Polynomial R), Δ = commutatorDefect A σ := by
  rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  exact hclass (fittingBoundaryClass_commutatorDefect m A σ)

/-- **Non-fake boundary defects exist**, so the commutator vanishing is a genuine restriction and not
vacuity.  A one-slot presentation with `det A = X²` carries the defect `Δ = 1` with boundary class
`1 ≠ 0` — a non-fake defect, necessarily a non-commutator by the theorem above. -/

  · have hadj : (Matrix.of ![![(X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ 2]]).adjugate = 1 := Matrix.adjugate_fin_one _
    rw [fittingBoundaryClass, fittingBoundaryTrace, hadj, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_fin_one,
      Matrix.one_apply_eq]

# Static Gaussian crossing memory

A matrix pencil with ordinary classical Gaussian coefficients and its free-Fock semicircular
surrogate have different Wick combinatorics.  At fourth order the classical moment retains one
crossing pairing that the free/noncrossing moment omits.  This file identifies that missing term
exactly.

For a Hermitian coefficient family `A`, the crossing memory is

`square fourth energy - (1/2) * commutator energy`.

Thus Hall fullness or atomlessness of the free pencil does not by itself transfer spectral decay
to a quenched static Hamiltonian.  Any valid transfer must control this crossing memory and its
higher-order analogues.  For a commuting family the commutator correction vanishes and the
crossing term is the entire square fourth energy, so the classical and noncrossing fourth moments
are provably different whenever that energy is nonzero.
-/

open Matrix

/-- Ordinary matrix commutator, kept explicit because the theorem compares associative Wick
words rather than Lie-algebra elements. -/
def matrixCommutator {N : Type*} [Fintype N]
    (A B : Matrix N N ℂ) : Matrix N N ℂ :=
  A * B - B * A

/-- The commutator of two Hermitian matrices is skew-Hermitian. -/
theorem matrixCommutator_conjTranspose_of_hermitian
    {N : Type*} [Fintype N]
    {A B : Matrix N N ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hB : Bᴴ = B) :
    (matrixCommutator A B)ᴴ = -matrixCommutator A B := by
  simp [matrixCommutator, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hA, hB, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Cyclic trace expansion of the squared commutator. -/
theorem trace_matrixCommutator_sq
    {N : Type*} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (A B : Matrix N N ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixCommutator A B * matrixCommutator A B) =
      2 * Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) -
        2 * Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) := by
  have hABBA : Matrix.trace (A * B * (B * A)) = Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace (A * B * (B * A)) = Matrix.trace ((A * B * B) * A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * (A * B * B)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hBAAB : Matrix.trace (B * A * (A * B)) = Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace (B * A * (A * B)) = Matrix.trace (B * (A * A * B)) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace ((A * A * B) * B) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hBABA : Matrix.trace (B * A * (B * A)) = Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) := by
    calc
      Matrix.trace (B * A * (B * A)) = Matrix.trace ((B * A * B) * A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * (B * A * B)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hABAB : Matrix.trace (A * B * (A * B)) = Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp only [matrixCommutator, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub]
  rw [hABAB, hABBA, hBAAB, hBABA]
  ring

/-- For Hermitian coefficients, Hilbert--Schmidt commutator energy is the negative trace of the
squared commutator. -/
theorem hsInner_matrixCommutator_self
    {N : Type*} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    {A B : Matrix N N ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hB : Bᴴ = B) :
    QuantumAlg.hsInner (matrixCommutator A B) (matrixCommutator A B) =
      2 * Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) -
        2 * Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) := by
  rw [QuantumAlg.hsInner_def,
    matrixCommutator_conjTranspose_of_hermitian hA hB,
    Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.trace_neg, trace_matrixCommutator_sq]
  ring

/-- Pairwise crossing law: a crossing word equals square energy minus half the
Hilbert--Schmidt commutator energy. -/
theorem trace_crossing_eq_square_sub_half_commutatorEnergy
    {N : Type*} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    {A B : Matrix N N ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hB : Bᴴ = B) :
    Matrix.trace (A * B * A * B) =
      Matrix.trace (A * A * B * B) -
